message:
Astra: Leaving the review’s effectiveness unresolved, what decision or unfinished work from “Executing the Review” needs to survive your latest distillation, and what does the actual note preserve?

How might Rohin’s reported raw-child Next-Steps handshake—carry an unfinished step forward, then check what actually happened before reporting progress—help you judge whether this handoff lets you resume your review?

Would more thinking settle what information the handoff needs, or would a small attempt to use it provide better evidence; which uncertainty deserves that attention, and when would further checking become redundant?

What thinking or doing step do you choose next for this handoff, and will you carry it out here rather than only announce it?

What observation would make you change that choice?

After that attempt, what finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn in your own concise words, and which visible passage supports your finding?
